answer: To establish a secure haven against Sybil proliferation, the network enforces quadratic stake burning for each additional agent instance: minting the nth identity requires permanently burning S(n)=k*n^2 in collateral. Under this superlinear cost scaling, attacker expenditure scales exponentially with scale, ensuring any rogue node creates only a minor ripple that fails to compromise consensus. Staked capital is locked in a time-weighted glacier deposit that burns progressively if coordination anomalies emerge.
